meta.title: Tom Packs His Luggage
meta.textType: story: a sequence with linking words

paragraphs: On the last evening of the term, Tom had a big blue bag on his bed. The next morning, Teacher Nick's class went to a camp at the lake. The camp was for one night. The bag was empty, and there were clothes on the floor. Tom saw the ad on the school board a week before. It said, "LAKE CAMP, ONE NIGHT. Please bring a flashlight and a towel."

First, Tom put his list on the bed. The list had eight things, and Tom counted them one by one. Then he began to pack his luggage carefully. He put in two shirts, a pair of shorts, and a clean towel. Seven things from the list were in the bag, and one thing was missing. He looked for his flashlight, but it was not in his room. "Lily, do you have my flashlight?" he called. "No!" said Lily from the kitchen.

After that, Tom went to the hall to look in the shoe box. Pip was very quiet that evening, but Tom did not notice. When he came back, one of his socks was not on the bed. "Pip!" said Tom. He heard small feet on the floor in the hall. Tom ran after the sound, but he could not find the puppy. "Lily, come and help me!" he said.

Lily looked in every room, and in the end she opened the bathroom door. Pip was in the empty bathtub with Tom's sock and a towel. He looked up at her with big eyes. He lay on the towel and did not move. Lily took a photo and laughed. "I think I know the reason," she said. "Pip does not want you to go to the camp." Tom took Pip in his arms, and the puppy put his nose on his face.

Finally, Tom put the sock back in his bag. Lily found the flashlight in the kitchen drawer, and he packed that too. Then Tom closed the zipper of the bag. "Is everything ready?" asked Mom. "Yes, all eight things," said Tom. "Thank you," he said to his sister. "And thank you too, Pip." Mom came to the door again and said, "It is time to sleep." That night, Pip slept on the floor next to the blue bag.
text.summary: Tom packs his luggage for a one-night camp at the lake at the end of the term. Pip takes a sock, and Lily finds him in the bathtub. Then Tom finishes and leaves.

sentences.text: On the last evening of the term, Tom had a big blue bag on his bed.
The next morning, Teacher Nick's class went to a camp at the lake.
The camp was for one night.
The bag was empty, and there were clothes on the floor.
Tom saw the ad on the school board a week before.
It said, "LAKE CAMP, ONE NIGHT. Please bring a flashlight and a towel."
First, Tom put his list on the bed.
The list had eight things, and Tom counted them one by one.
Then he began to pack his luggage carefully.
He put in two shirts, a pair of shorts, and a clean towel.
Seven things from the list were in the bag, and one thing was missing.
He looked for his flashlight, but it was not in his room.
"Lily, do you have my flashlight?" he called.
"No!" said Lily from the kitchen.
After that, Tom went to the hall to look in the shoe box.
Pip was very quiet that evening, but Tom did not notice.
When he came back, one of his socks was not on the bed.
"Pip!" said Tom.
He heard small feet on the floor in the hall.
Tom ran after the sound, but he could not find the puppy.
"Lily, come and help me!" he said.
Lily looked in every room, and in the end she opened the bathroom door.
Pip was in the empty bathtub with Tom's sock and a towel.
He looked up at her with big eyes.
He lay on the towel and did not move.
Lily took a photo and laughed.
"I think I know the reason," she said.
"Pip does not want you to go to the camp."
Tom took Pip in his arms, and the puppy put his nose on his face.
Finally, Tom put the sock back in his bag.
Lily found the flashlight in the kitchen drawer, and he packed that too.
Then Tom closed the zipper of the bag.
"Is everything ready?" asked Mom.
"Yes, all eight things," said Tom.
"Thank you," he said to his sister.
"And thank you too, Pip."
Mom came to the door again and said, "It is time to sleep."
That night, Pip slept on the floor next to the blue bag.
